children.value: > Fact From Story: Erik ten Hag's side have once again dropped points from a winning position as they drew 3-3 with Galatasaray in the Champions League, a damaging result in their bid to reach the last 16.
> > Fact From Story: United now have to beat Bayern Munich and hope Galatasaray draw with FC Copenhagen on the final matchday to progress.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A team needs to win games to progress in a tournament.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Drawing a game instead of winning it means not improving the team's position in the standings.
